decisions.reason: As a burner component squarely within the firm's existing heating know-how, its strong relatedness and the firm's in-house R&D make learning and incremental improvement feasible, so withdrawal is possible but not likely.

This flagship electric infrared panel line builds directly on the firm's established offer and strategic move toward lower-carbon solutions, and the firm's strong engineering and R&D base supports continued refinement rather than exit.

Although it is close to the firm's existing infrared expertise, this halogen electric heater looks more exposed to internal overlap and portfolio pruning than the main focus lines, so it is kept but with a somewhat higher discontinuation risk.

An industrial electric infrared hall-heater line is closely related to the firm's core customer base and application knowledge, so its absorptive capacity is high and the firm is likely to continue developing it.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is both close to the firm's gas-heating competence and central to its future low-carbon positioning, so despite market uncertainty the firm is likely to retain it and learn from early field use.
